content_blocks.label: clause_1._Disposition_of_Estate
content_blocks.text: I hereby dispose of my estate as follows: all personal property to my daughter, Elizabeth Thorne.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Executors
content_blocks.text: Charles Thorne is appointed Executor of this will and shall carry out the provisions hereof.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Witnesses
content_blocks.text: This will is witnessed by Johnathan Oakley and Emily Morgenstern, both of whom are over the age of 18.
